verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs describe both public and private status pages that take about a minute to set up and are meant for internal stakeholders and external customers. A public JSON API served on the status page's custom domain confirms custom-domain hosting, and it exposes current status and incident data, which implies the page reflects incident state. Missing for 10: subscriber notifications (email/SMS/webhook subscribers) are never documented, the automatic incident-to-status-page linkage is only implied, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
